cells.name: softmax-2pass
cells.text:
(program softmax-2pass
  (input x)
  (pass a
    (state m d)
    (block (m (rmax x))
           (d (sum (exp (- x m)))))
    (merge (m (max L.m R.m))
           (d (+ (* L.d (exp (- L.m m))) (* R.d (exp (- R.m m)))))))
  (output elementwise (/ (exp (- x a.m)) a.d)))

cells.name: softmax-lse1
cells.text:
(program softmax-lse1
  (input x)
  (pass a
    (state s)
    (block (mx (rmax x))
           (s (+ mx (log (sum (exp (- x mx)))))))
    (merge (mm (max L.s R.s))
           (s (+ mm (log (+ (exp (- L.s mm)) (exp (- R.s mm))))))))
  (output elementwise (exp (- x a.s))))

cells.name: softmax-3pass
cells.text:
(program softmax-3pass
  (input x)
  (pass a
    (state m)
    (block (m (rmax x)))
    (merge (m (max L.m R.m))))
  (pass b
    (state d)
    (block (d (sum (exp (- x a.m)))))
    (merge (d (+ L.d R.d))))
  (output elementwise (/ (exp (- x a.m)) b.d)))
